item.title: South-eastern Europe faces heatwave energy crunch as Romania detonates Danube rock to increase water flow – Europe live
item.summary: Explosives used to move a large rock and let more water flow to cool nuclear power plant Here’s a better look at the impressive controlled explosion in Romania… Meanwhile in Romania, the Romanian naval forces carried out a controlled explosion to divert a large volume of water to the Old Danube and the Cernavodă nuclear power plant to help with its cooling.
